title: RAW: independently labeled phoneme recovery versus reversible nonphonetic register-record controls
summary: Calibrate one fixed opaque-symbol class learner against official pronunciation classes and two reversible register/value procedural sources, with within-record shuffle controls. Separate known-class recovery from alternation-based phonetic-origin claims; no native data or sound assignments.

positive.contract: A pinned independently classified pronunciation dataset, such as the official dictionary root is considering, tests recovery of its independently labeled C/V segments after opaque relabeling. Existing ASJP can serve only if independent segment labels and capacity are adequate.
positive.smallest_exact_question: Does the unchanged signed-cut objective admit a one-phone flip improving on true supplied C/V? A witness excludes exact optimum identification without a full optimizer.
positive.approximate_question: Approximate class recovery needs an actual frozen estimator plus comparison to independent truth; a one-flip certificate cannot answer it. Report balanced type-class recovery and frequency-weighted recovery separately, with uncertainty or rare-class limitations.
leakage_rules: Split by base lexeme, keeping alternative pronunciations together.
Predeclare canonical pronunciation or total per-lexeme weight1; do not multiply variants unnoticed.
Stress stripping only via official phone inventory; unknown symbols remain errors/unscorable, not guessed classes.
Fix orientation from training truth or explicitly use a complement-invariant score; do not choose orientation per held subset.
positive.limits: Modern dictionary pronunciation is not medieval source language, running speech or evidence of Voynich phonemes. No syllable boundaries inferred from dictionary phones alone.

negative.purpose: Measure specificity of the same structural positive criterion against actual nonphonetic content-bearing records, not merely shuffled characters.

control_A.construction: Three ordered SET(register,value) instructions serialize as R V R V R V using disjoint opaque inventories for register IDs and literal values. Exactly decode every instruction pair; overwrite order retained in message. Inventories and dataset choices fixed before outcomes.
control_A.analytic_prediction: After removal of the two endpoints, V R V R has3 crossings and bag expectation2, so excess per edge1/3. Identities and repetitions do not alter role pattern.
control_A.scope: This is a proof that alternation alone can be positive for nonphonetic instructions; not proof that the learned maximum uniquely identifies these roles on every finite sample.

control_B.construction: Three ordered assignments; each address is a path of1or2 address symbols, each value a1or2-digit sequence from a disjoint value alphabet. Field lengths independently equiprobable, fixed before any score. Role changes delimit fields; global opaque bijection hides symbol names.
control_B.content: Ordered path and value digit sequences decode exactly; no phonetics. Register paths and value integers are source-defined, not manuscript meanings.
control_B.sampling: Root must freeze inventories, leading-zero convention or treat value as literal digit sequence, seed, train/test record counts and weighting before generation. Do not tune runs or select favorable seeds after a phoneme result.
control_B.purpose: Avoid a negative suite containing only perfectly alternating records; evaluate the same test on a nonphonetic grammar with within-role runs.

negative.reporting: A negative structural positive is a false positive only for an explicitly claimed phonetic-origin decision rule. High recovery of procedural roles is correct role recovery, not a phoneme mistake by itself. Never equate label recovery on known positive data with generic phonetic-origin discrimination.

source_update: Root selects a pinned official CMU pronunciation dictionary plus its independent phone-type metadata. ASJP remains an owned small-source alternative audited separately. No source acquisition by this producer.

selection_contract.learner: A fixed39-symbol multistart signed-maxcut learner, using the1264 mathematical objective. Root freezes starts, seed, tie-breaking, rounding and stopping before data scoring. This is a bounded optimizer, not a proof of global optimum.
selection_contract.positive_size: Root proposes8192training and8192test unique phoneme sequences. Stress removed under official symbols. Keep base lexemes and identical phoneme sequences out of opposing sets; exact partition construction must be frozen before evaluation.
selection_contract.labels: Official independent C/V classes remain hidden from training optimization. Complement orientation learned using TRAIN truth only, or fixed complement-invariant accuracy explicitly reported.
selection_contract.negative_sources: Strict three-pair records and variable1/2-symbol field records, using disjoint opaque register/value inventories totaling39symbols. Each complete record preserves and decodes every instruction, not just terminal register state.
selection_contract.null: Shuffle within each retained record with independently frozen seeds; preserve its symbol bag and length. This is a weak baseline in addition to, not instead of, the procedural negative controls.
selection_contract.endpoints: Known class accuracy on positive controls and known role recovery on procedural controls are distinct from the same held alternation-effect criterion applied to both. Report all cases. A procedural role-recovery success is not by itself a false-positive phonetic classification; that term applies only to an explicit origin criterion.
selection_contract.independent_check: Validate dictionary phone normalization, source splits, opaque maps, complete procedural inverse, same score objective, truth comparisons and test no-refit. Negative semantic roles are synthetic source definitions, never native meanings.

identifiability_limit: A whole-word lookup mechanism can produce identical strings and thus identical output statistics without sound computations. Controls can establish sensitivity/specificity against fixed mechanisms, never every possible nonphonetic writer.

predecessors.GDT1346: Orthographic benchmark nonoptimality is retained; new independently supplied phone classes address its explicit annotation limit, not repair native1264/1278.
predecessors.Q20P001: Owned ASJP audit and failed language-specific mapping are retained; no Q20 target reopened.
predecessors.GDT1218: Closed≤64 whole-word name alternation is distinct from these nonnative symbol-level control records.
predecessors.GDT1264_1265_1278_1279_1285: Structural positives, predictive failures and exact-identity gains retain their original scopes.

checks: Bounded live-route/control-topic, pronunciation/phoneme search, source audit, route/duplicate checks in PHONEME_CONTROL_SUPPLY_20261012.json; not an exhaustive novelty claim.
work_limits: No native input, phoneme assignments to Voynich, meaning or decoder.
Modern dictionary results do not identify manuscript language or medieval pronunciation.
Root must preregister actual selection, gates and implementation budget before evaluation.
